title: Pickleball Sticker, Official Kitchen Inspector Vinyl Sticker, Funny Paddle and Water Bottle Decal
description:
The kitchen has an official inspector, and it's you. A shield-shaped die-cut sticker for paddles, water bottles and laptops.

Who it's for:
- Players who love calling kitchen faults
- Stocking stuffers and party favours
- Club prizes

About the design:
A navy shield with lime and coral banners, a magnifying-glass pickleball and a clean white die-cut border.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
